queries_run: APH Amphenol market share gaining OR losing 2026
Amphenol new entrant OR displace threat Electronic Components 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 列名主要對手：Aptiv、Belden、Corning、Foxconn Interconnect、Glenair、HUBER+SUHNER、立訊、中航光電、Molex、Rosenberger、Sensata、TE、Yazaki 等，另有大量細分區域／產品的小廠。
findings.excerpt: Primary competitors include Aptiv, Belden, Corning, Foxconn Interconnect Technology, Glenair, HUBER+SUHNER, ICT Luxshare, Jonhon, Molex, Rosenberger, Sensata, TE Connectivity and Yazaki, among others.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：技術快速變動可能引入各種規模的新進入者，競爭可能導致降價、毛利下降或份額流失；AI 需求的延續取決於公司後續市占。
findings.excerpt: Rapid technological changes could also lead to the entry of new competitors of various sizes, against whom we may not be able to successfully compete.

findings.claim: 10-K 指出客戶長期持續把合格供應商名單集中給具備技術、品質、交期能力者。
findings.excerpt: For many years, customers have generally been consolidating their lists of qualified suppliers to companies that have the ability to meet certain technical, quality, delivery and other standards while maintaining geographic flexibility and competitive prices.

findings.claim: 報導稱 Amphenol 面臨 TE Connectivity、Bel Fuse 競爭加劇（CommScope 收購報導）。
